peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 23.2% below its local comparables; 11 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (71.8): 4.2 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 277 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 10). Context, not scored: resales in 20.8% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison; the size-matched price position applies.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Farrer Park MRT about 490 m, Novena MRT about 950 m; closer than 338 of 662 similar developments (the same as 13). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 7 within 2 km; nearest Farrer Park Primary School about 520 m; more than 547 of 662 similar developments (the same as 73). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 14 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 330 m), more than 648 of 662 similar developments (the same as 13); nearest hawker centre Pek Kio Market And Food Centre about 210 m; nearest park Mount Emily Park about 1,390 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Pek Kio Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 7 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 690 m; Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 1,150 m; 32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 1,420 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 1,420 m; The Arcady at Boon Keng, 32 new sales, about 1,500 m; Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 1,660 m; The Collective at One Sophia, 16 new sales, about 1,750 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 358 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 84 new sales and 993 resales (1,077 purchases); new sales were 7.8% of these purchases. Subsales (44) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Dorset Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 280 m; The Serra Residences (launch, launched, about 4 homes), about 820 m; upcoming Sophia Meadow development, about 1,650 m; Bukit Timah Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,690 m; Peck Hay Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,780 m; Kallang Close GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,860 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 993 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 563 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 993 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,064 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−6.7%). Planning-area private resales −11.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
